profile:title: Profile
profile:anonymous__note: Stands in for a display name before the user has an account. Max 14 characters.
profile:level__note: Level badge on Profile. {level} is a number.
profile:level.next__note: How much XP remains. Both are whole numbers.
profile:level.max__note: Shown instead of a countdown at the top level. Max 22 characters.
profile:stats.title: Your numbers
profile:stats.title__note: Section heading above the stat grid. Max 16 characters.
profile:stats.streak__note: Stat label for the current streak. Max 12 characters.
profile:stats.longest__note: Stat label for the longest streak ever. Max 12 characters.
profile:stats.countries__note: Stat label for fully learned countries. Max 12 characters.
profile:world.title: Your world
profile:world.title__note: Section heading above the per-continent bars. Max 16 characters.
profile:world.summary__note: Overall progress. Both are whole numbers.
profile:account.title: Save your progress
profile:account.body: You are learning without an account. Creating one keeps your streak safe if you change phone.
profile:empty.title: Nothing to show yet
profile:empty.body: Finish your first lesson and your numbers will start here.
profile:empty.cta__note: Button in the Profile empty state. The body copy tells the user to finish a lesson; this is the control that starts one. Max 18 characters.
profile:levelTitle__note: Level and earned title together, e.g. 'Level 20 · Navigator'.
profile:week.title: This week
profile:week.title__note: Heading above the seven-day activity bars.
profile:week.none__note: Empty state for the weekly bars. Neutral — never 'you missed 7 days'.
profile:week.day: {day}: {count, plural, =0 {no lessons} one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}
profile:week.day__note: Accessibility label for one activity bar. {day} is a weekday name.
profile:shop.cta__note: Row on Profile that opens the shop. Sits under the title it changes; never on Home, where it would put a purchase in front of somebody who opened the app to learn. Max 10 characters.
